reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), Vietnamese (vi), and Thai (th) nursery-to-field planting observation UI. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Observed field planting is distinguished from planned field entry (UTC calendar date) and saved plan references; (2) Planted count requires an integer number where explicitly entered 0 is zero and blank is uncounted; (3) Observations do not deduct stock, determine survival (成活 / sự sống sót / การรอดตาย, avoiding rate concepts), or mark batches complete; (4) Checked labels mean user-selected checkbox labels preserved/snapshotted as entered (保存快照 / lưu giữ / บันทึกข้อมูล), avoiding camera/image capture connotations; (5) General nursery stock and evidence wording (育苗) is preserved without seedbed limitation; (6) Thai row 17 reflects current withholding and non-ordinary-note handling rather than future promises; (7) Simplified Chinese row 13 expresses what was actually observed; (8) Exact ASCII literals DEMO, UTC, and 0 are preserved. Terms for human review: naturalness of nursery raising batches versus field planting terms in local dialects. No runtime activation or semantic certification is claimed.
